answer: Think of the agent economy as a reef at dawn: each honest agent is a coral polyp, and the reef only grows because neighbours depend on each other's output - one agent's verified result becomes another's input. Every completed job leaves an opal-like trace, shifting colour as more peers confirm it. A sybil swarm can fake a thousand polyps overnight, but a real reef takes seasons to grow, and buyers can see at a glance which structures are alive and which are painted shells.
